# Avocado Digital

> Avocado Digital (Avocado Pty Ltd) is a small Australian software and strategy studio, established 2021 in Melbourne, building durable tools for small and medium businesses — bespoke software, curated technology and strategy consulting, plus four products of its own: EzyBiz, Call Concierge, SocialReels and Claudette.

Key facts:

- Services: Workflow Solutions (bespoke software and workflow automation), Curated Technology (pragmatic tool selection and integration), Strategy Consulting (strategy intensives, roadmap shaping, pre-mortems, fractional CTO).
- Legal entity: Avocado Pty Ltd, ACN 652 199 687, ABN 81 652 199 687.
- Contact: hello@avocadodigital.com.au · Reception +61 3 6358 8887

## Products

- [EzyBiz](https://ezybiz.ai/): the ultimate business phone for legal professionals — a dedicated business number with an Australian AI answering service (call screening, message taking, appointment booking) and every call filed to the right matter in Smokeball or Clio. Also mirrored at https://avocadodigital.com.au/ezybiz — see https://ezybiz.ai/llms.txt for full details.
- [Call Concierge](https://callconcierge.com.au): live Australian new-client intake for law firms, connected to EzyBiz.
- [SocialReels](https://socialreels.ai): short-form video for small business (private beta).
- [Claudette](https://github.com/Avocado-Pty-Ltd/Claudette): an open-source, voice-based IDE that turns speech into a working codebase (MIT licence, on GitHub).

## Services

- [Workflow Solutions](https://avocadodigital.com.au/workflow-solutions.html): bespoke software and workflow automation
- [Curated Technology](https://avocadodigital.com.au/curated-tech.html): tool selection and integration
- [Strategy Consulting](https://avocadodigital.com.au/strategy-consulting.html): strategy intensives, roadmaps, fractional CTO
